'''Tundan robes''' were a style of robes commonly worn by the [[Sorcerers of Tund/Legends|Sorcerers of Tund]], an offshoot sect of [[Sith sorcerer]]s descended from heretical [[Kissai]] [[Kissai heretics|outcasts]]<ref name="WE5" /> and [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]]-[[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Hybrid/Legends|hybrid]] refugees who fled to [[Tund/Legends|Tund]] during the [[post–Great Hyperspace War counterinvasion]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> These heavy robes ranged from dark red<ref name="JATM" /><ref name="JvS" /> to deep gray<ref name="TDSS" /> in color and notably concealed the wearer's entire body and face<ref name="JATM" /><ref name="JvS" /> in a series of wraps and a headdress-like cowl.<ref name="TDSS" />

[[Karnak Tetsu]], the leader of the Sorcerers of Tund during the [[Dark Wars]]<ref name="WE5" /> and a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force user]] known as "the Maleficent,"<ref name="TIW">{{SW|url=news/the-imperial-warlords-despoilers-of-an-empire-part-3|series=The Imperial Warlords: Despoilers of an Empire|text=Part 3|nolive=1}}</ref> was one individual known to have worn Tundan robes in conjunction with his [[Sith talisman/Legends|Sith amulet]].<ref name="WE5" /> The last Sorcerer of Tund, a [[Croke]] infiltrator by the name of [[Rokur Gepta]], similarly sported his own set of Tundan robes prior to his [[Destruction of Tund|destruction of the planet]] in [[5 BBY/Legends|5 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Though the distinctive robes of the Sorcerers of Tund have been offhandedly mentioned in a number of sourcebooks and reference books, they were first given the explicit name "Tundan robes" in Web Enhancement 5 of the ''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''.
